# POINT-FULL-MAP-RMS-METHOD v0.1 Recovery Brief

Status: `unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`; separate quarantined
recovery not launched

## Objective

Recover an implementation-independent authority for the exact RMS denominator
used only by `fitted_amplitude_over_full_map_rms` and legacy alias
`sig2noise`. This method is scientifically and lifecycle-distinct from the
compatibility-fit and formal-error methods.

## Required Record

The sanitized record shall bind exact parent signal role/product/version/
generation, scientific row population called full map, about-zero RMS versus
centered standard deviation, center/mean calculation, weighting, source-region
inclusion/exclusion, support/edge/validity, missing/non-finite and zero-
denominator behavior, units/cancellation, lifecycle/provenance, and identity
relation to the fitted amplitude parent.

Every recovered fact must be classified as established compatibility behavior,
scientific interpretation, representation detail, historical non-authority, or
unresolved owner choice. Missing science must not be inferred from familiar
labels, software behavior, or configuration.

## Release Gate

The method remains unavailable until exact sanitized bytes and digest receive
explicit scientific-owner approval. Its absence blocks only the dynamic-range
diagnostic and aliases; it does not block an otherwise authorized fit,
displacement, effective-shape product, or formal error.
